title: console: grid grouping and dashboard category axes/legends order a select field's values alphabetically, not in the field's declared option order
body:
**Filing gate ① — product defect with a named location and a reproduction.** reach: showcase Tasks list → Group → Status, and the *Delivery Operations* dashboard, in the end-user console.

**Who acts on it:** objectui triage → the console / records owner. ⛔ Not a claim. Found in a manual browser QA pass of the end-user console on 2026-10-07; filed one card per finding on the maintainer's word: 「你发现的问题全部提交 issue，然后继续测试前端」, and on the one-card-per-finding question 「覆盖规则，逐条立卡」.

## What happens

`showcase_task.status` declares Backlog → To Do → In Progress → In Review → Done, and `priority` Low → Medium → High → Urgent. Several surfaces drop that order and sort by label:
- Grid *Group by Status*: groups appear as Backlog, Done, In Progress, In Review, To Do.
- Dashboard *Tasks by Status* bar chart x-axis: Backlog, Done, In Progress, In Review, To Do.
- Dashboard *Priority Mix* legend: High, Low, Medium, Urgent.
The same app gets it right elsewhere: the Kanban board's columns and the dashboard's own *Task Status* filter both list the values in declared order.

## Expected

Groups, category axes and legends for a select/picklist dimension follow the field's option order (empty/unknown values last).

## Suggested direction (triage to rule)

Sort grouped rows and chart categories by the option index from the field metadata when the dimension is a select, falling back to label order only for free text.

## Environment

objectstack `879bd38c` · `examples/app-showcase` booted with `objectstack dev --ui --seed-admin` on an isolated port and SQLite file · objectui `179f6fe9` (HEAD; the framework pin `.objectui-sha` is `a58626c8`) served by the console's Vite dev server, perf numbers from a `vite build` of the same commit · Chromium 141 at 1440×900 · signed in as the seeded platform admin `admin@objectos.ai` unless stated.
